data.name: Repeats PC - Motor boat
data.detailed_description:
Repeats – Motor Boat

Repeats – Motor Boat is a high-quality marine simulation experience designed to let users enjoy boat operation at home with realism close to actual handling. Going beyond a simple game, it faithfully reproduces various maritime conditions—wave motion, tidal flow, wind changes, and limited visibility—to deliver a deeply immersive feeling as if you were navigating on real water.

Because the simulator is based on the practical training program for the Korean Class-2 Motorboat Operator License, both beginners and license candidates can safely practice the exact procedures and steps used in the real examination.

Another key advantage is the ability to repeat difficult maneuvers as many times as needed without the real-world constraints of weather, time, or distance.

Users can evaluate their skills through the Exam Mode, which follows the actual test procedures, or naturally build handling instincts through the Training Mode, where they can freely explore the virtual sea. In addition, the Scenario Mode, featuring changing weather and unexpected situations, helps improve crisis-response capabilities.

Repeats – Motor Boat is appealing not only to those who want to learn boat handling but also to anyone who simply wants to experience steering a vessel. Maneuvers that must be performed cautiously in reality can be attempted freely in the virtual environment, helping users build confidence with ease.

For beginners, it becomes the safest first step toward learning the sea, and for thrill-seekers, it offers a new and exciting marine experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super, AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700, Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
